seeds: 6000001..6000192, 192 paired seeds, 768 episodes, no extension used

what_is_now_established.conflicting_best_responses: CONFIRMED, replicated on a second untouched block. GUARD strictly dominates against A (BREACH won 34% vs GUARD 64%); BREACH strictly dominates against OP7 (GUARD won 0.5% vs BREACH 46%).
what_is_now_established.hidden_strategic_context_both_sides: CONFIRMED, prospectively, on both poles. Intent was observable in only 52.1% of A episodes and 31.8% of B episodes; commitment preceded intent in 94.3% (A) and 91.7% (B) of episodes.
what_is_now_established.why_both_sides_had_to_pass: if only one pole concealed, a reactive policy could infer the other pole by elimination (clear signal -> known context; no signal -> the other context by default), which would not require persistent strategy. Both sides resisting early identification closes that route.
what_is_now_established.not_yet_established: that LEARNING actually discovers or needs the two modes. An environment that ADMITS a valuable two-strategy solution does not guarantee PPO finds one instead of converging on a single mediocre-everywhere policy. That is the next, separate test.

developmental_vs_confirmed_numbers.reading: confirmed came in ABOVE the development estimate, not below. Consistent with the natural-replicate finding that the n=32 development estimate was itself noisy (implied SD(d)~0.875) rather than optimistic. The n=192 amendment was the right call independent of which direction the noise broke.
developmental_vs_confirmed_numbers.reading_B: the retrospective OP7 reading from the SDS_G1_4 run was not an artifact of hindsight selection -- it replicated prospectively on an independent block, slightly higher if anything.

integrity_checks_before_reporting.poles_are_genuinely_distinct_data: 384 rows each; only 69/384 (18%) score-cell coincidences between A and B, matching background rate rather than duplication
integrity_checks_before_reporting.seed_symmetry: both poles evaluated on the identical 192-seed set (6000001..6000192), by design, for experimental symmetry
integrity_checks_before_reporting.block_provenance: 6000001..6000192 audited CLEAN under the corrected audit tool (f03cefd4), including the git-history check with a firing positive control
integrity_checks_before_reporting.no_threshold_moved: 0.15 payoff floor, LCB95>0, and the 0.50 p_C floor are byte-identical to their frozen values; no extension was used

what_this_licenses.immediate: the environment now demonstrably requires conflicting, concealed strategic responses -- the precondition the whole Summer 2026 campaign was built to establish
what_this_licenses.next_gate_before_latent: explicit GUARD/BREACH repertoire value MUST be shown to exceed the best single generalist PPO before any latent-conditioned policy is trained. An environment that admits two valuable modes does not guarantee a generalist fails to find one adequate policy; that is a separate, harder question answered by training, not by this confirmation.
still_prohibited: training a latent-conditioned policy until the repertoire-beats-generalist gate is separately cleared
